study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: timing of enrollment in a collaborative care model
outcome: moderately severe or severe postpartum depressive symptoms at 6 weeks postpartum (PHQ-9 score ≥15)
cohort: Perinatal individuals enrolled in a collaborative care model at a quaternary academic center between 2017 and 2021.
finding: Antepartum hospital admission was associated with higher rates of moderately severe to severe postpartum depressive symptoms, an association that did not exist among individuals enrolled in collaborative care during pregnancy.
